news_codex_ratings.json.review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.
Only material new or materially changed evidence is reviewed in this run. Valid current-session ratings are carried forward when still supported; an unreviewed story is not a Neutral rating.

The new Business Recorder oil link was not directly readable in this cloud session. Its committed headline and timestamp were cross-checked against the full Reuters report republished by MarketScreener, so the oil update is marked full_secondary rather than direct-body evidence.

The linked Mettis FZCM article body was inaccessible. Its raw timestamp is internally impossible at this run because it is encoded as 11:34 UTC even though the raw file was fetched at 06:47 UTC. The FZCM item is therefore recorded as headline-only with no trusted article publication timestamp.

Fresh ADB and wheat-support-price republications repeat stories already present earlier in the session and do not add a new tracked-company cash-flow fact. They are not treated as new neutral ratings.

reviewed_stories.title: Oil falls $1 on better supply outlook, hopes for US-Iran talks
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector evidence for tracked Oil & Gas Exploration names OGDC, PPL and MARI.
reviewed_stories.reason: This materially strengthens the existing oil-supply thread. Brent was reported at $98.16, down 1.1%, after Saudi Arabia restarted the East-West Pipeline, Saudi and Iraqi export availability improved, and US crude inventories rose. The direction for upstream crude exposure remains negative, with a weaker inference for MARI.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Business Recorder timestamp is from the committed raw feed. The full Reuters text was independently read from MarketScreener, published 2026-09-23 at 00:45 EDT.

reviewed_stories.title: FZCM restores Blow Room to full capacity after fire incident
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: FZCM is Fazal Cloth Mills Limited, verified on PSX, but it is outside the repository's current tracked universe.
reviewed_stories.reason: The headline indicates an operational recovery to full Blow Room capacity after a fire, which is directionally positive for FZCM. The article body was inaccessible, so no downtime, loss, insurance, production or earnings effect is inferred, and no tracked-stock or sector rating is created.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Headline-only. The raw timestamp is not trusted because it is later than the raw file's own fetch time.

OGDC.reason: Brent fell to $98.16 as Saudi Arabia restored a major bypass pipeline, Saudi and Iraqi export availability improved, and US crude inventories rose. Those developments weaken the crude-price tailwind for an upstream producer. Regional conflict risk remains, so confidence stays moderate.
OGDC.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; OGDC is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

PPL.reason: Brent fell to $98.16 as Saudi Arabia restored a major bypass pipeline, Saudi and Iraqi export availability improved, and US crude inventories rose. Those developments weaken the crude-price tailwind for an upstream producer. Regional conflict risk remains, so confidence stays moderate.
PPL.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; PPL is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

MARI.reason: Brent fell to $98.16 as Gulf supply availability improved. That is negative for the oil-linked part of MARI's hydrocarbon exposure, but MARI is not a pure crude-price proxy, so the company-level inference is weaker than for OGDC and PPL.
MARI.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; MARI is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

Oil Marketing.reason: The fresh ex-depot price reset lowers petrol by Rs1.70 per litre and HSD by Rs3.12, but the article provides no evidence that OMC margin economics changed and does not quantify inventory or demand effects.
Oil Marketing.relevance: Sector link: Oil Marketing, including PSO.
